about: Service exposure probe catalog - unauthenticated exposure checks for common network services.

probes.label: Redis no-authentication (PING/PONG)
probes.remediation: Enable requirepass and restrict bind to trusted networks.
probes.note: A bare +PONG reply shows the instance accepts commands without a password.

probes.label: Redis INFO disclosure
probes.remediation: Bind Redis to internal interfaces and require authentication.
probes.note: INFO leaks version, memory, clients and keyspace stats when unauthenticated.

probes.label: MongoDB instance banner exposed
probes.remediation: Bind MongoDB to internal interfaces and enable authentication.
probes.note: Modern MongoDB is silent on a bare connect (binary wire); an empty expect flags any non-empty response. Binary hello/ismaster probes are handled by the wire-protocol module.

probes.label: Memcached unauthenticated stats (cache disclosure)
probes.remediation: Bind memcached to localhost or trusted networks; it has no authentication by design.
probes.note: stats returns STAT lines with item counts, bytes and hit ratio; values can be read unauthenticated via the get command.

probes.label: Memcached version disclosure
probes.remediation: Block UDP/TCP 11211 from untrusted networks.
probes.note: version returns e.g. VERSION 1.6.9 and confirms the instance.

probes.label: Elasticsearch instance banner (tagline/version)
probes.send:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Restrict 9200 and enable authentication (e.g. X-Pack) if exposure is unintended.
probes.note: The root JSON carries the tagline 'You Know, for Search' plus cluster and version fields.

probes.label: Elasticsearch cluster unauthenticated
probes.send:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Enable authentication/authorization and firewall 9200; never expose Elasticsearch publicly.
probes.note: Cluster metadata is readable without auth; _search/_cat APIs allow bulk data access from the network.

probes.label: Docker Engine API unauthenticated
probes.send:
GET /version HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Disable or firewall-off the TCP socket; use TLS with client certificates when remote.
probes.note: Full API control over containers, images and the host via privileged mounts - typically leads to host RCE.

probes.label: Kubernetes API server unauthenticated (version leak)
probes.send:
GET /version HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Restrict 6443 to trusted networks and enforce RBAC plus authenticated service accounts.
probes.note: gitVersion exposes cluster/version; anonymous or misconfigured kubelets can leak secrets and pods.

probes.label: Kubelet read-only port exposed
probes.remediation: Disable the --read-only-port (10255) listener and kubelet anonymous auth on 10250.
probes.note: 10255 served unauthenticated health and pod data; modern kubelets dropped it, so a hit implies an old or misconfigured node.

probes.label: etcd API unauthenticated
probes.send:
GET /version HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Enable client TLS and cert auth; restrict 2379 to control-plane hosts.
probes.note: etcdserver in /version confirms the API; unauthenticated you can read/write the whole key space (e.g. Kubernetes secrets).

probes.label: Consul agent API unauthenticated
probes.send:
GET /v1/agent/self HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Enable Consul ACLs, require TLS, and restrict the agent HTTP port to localhost.
probes.note: agent/self leaks node/config; /v1/kv reads and writes are open and script checks can lead to RCE.

probes.label: Consul status endpoint reachable
probes.send:
GET /v1/status/leader HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Apply Consul ACLs and restrict HTTP to trusted clients.
probes.note: The leader endpoint returns a JSON 'ip:port' string and helps enumerate the cluster; combine with /v1/agent/self for a definitive check.

probes.label: CockroachDB banner exposed
probes.remediation: Restrict 26257 to internal DB clients and enable TLS/cluster certs.
probes.note: CockroachDB speaks the Postgres wire protocol; nodeId may appear in the handshake/banner context - confirm with a PG startup message.

probes.label: InfluxDB exposed (version header)
probes.send:
GET /ping HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Require auth and firewall 8086/8088; avoid public exposure.
probes.note: /ping sets the X-Influxdb-Version header; the query API (/query) may also return data when auth is off.

probes.label: CouchDB unauthenticated (admin party)
probes.send:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Enable require_valid_user and restrict 5984/6984 to trusted hosts.
probes.note: A bare GET / returns {"couchdb":"Welcome"}; with 'admin party' any request is admitted, exposing _all_dbs and sessions.

probes.label: RabbitMQ AMQP banner
probes.remediation: Restrict 5672 to internal producers/consumers and enable TLS.
probes.note: The connection.start frame begins with 'AMQP' plus a protocol version; confirms the broker.

probes.label: RabbitMQ Management UI exposed
probes.send:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: x
Connection: close
probes.remediation: Restrict 15672 to the ops network and enforce strong credentials.
probes.note: Management login page; guest/guest default credentials remain enabled in some setups.

probes.label: ActiveMQ web console reachable
probes.remediation: Restrict 8161 to admins, change the default admin/admin credentials, and keep ActiveMQ patched.
probes.note: Console login page; old unauthenticated RCE paths exist via the console and the fileserver.

probes.label: ZooKeeper four-letter command accepted (no auth)
probes.remediation: Restrict 2181 and set 4lw.commands.whitelist or enable authentication.
probes.note: imok confirms a live server accepting 4lw commands without auth; srvr/stat/dump leak session, node and env data.

probes.label: ZooKeeper environment disclosure
probes.remediation: Whitelist 4lw commands or firewall the client port.
probes.note: envi returns zookeeper.version, classpaths and JVM flags.

probes.label: Zabbix agent reachable (ZBXD handshake)
probes.remediation: Enable TLS encryption and firewall 10050 to monitored hosts only.
probes.note: Agent replies carry the ZBXD binary header; a passive item request is needed for a full handshake.

probes.label: Kafka broker framing detected (null leading byte)
probes.remediation: Restrict 9092/9093 and require SASL/TLS for clients.
probes.note: Kafka is client-initiated; when the broker answers it opens with a 0x00 byte (length/correlation framing) at offset 0. 9093 usually means TLS.

probes.label: MySQL server banner
probes.remediation: Restrict 3306 to application hosts and use strong accounts.
probes.note: Greeting banner only; credentials are still required to reach data.

probes.label: PostgreSQL server banner
probes.remediation: Restrict 5432 to internal clients and enforce strong pg_hba authentication.
probes.note: Banner-only; a startup packet is needed for a full handshake and authentication.

probes.label: Microsoft SQL Server detected
probes.remediation: Restrict 1433/1434 to application hosts and enforce strong SQL authentication.
probes.note: PreLogin response; banner only - credentials are needed for data access.

probes.label: SMTP server EHLO response
probes.remediation: Restrict the port and ensure the relay is not open to arbitrary senders.
probes.note: 250- capability list; an open relay must be verified externally by RCPT TO to an external domain.

probes.label: LDAP directory reachable
probes.remediation: Restrict directory ports to corporate segments and enforce auth/TLS.
probes.note: LDAP is BER-encoded; a null lead byte marks a bind response. Anonymous bind is often enabled by default - check it separately. 636/3269 are TLS.

probes.label: FTP service banner
probes.remediation: Restrict 21 and require FTPS/TLS; review anonymous accounts.
probes.note: 220 = service ready; the banner often reveals server and version. Test anonymous login separately.

probes.label: SSH banner / OpenSSH version
probes.remediation: Keep the SSH daemon patched and restrict source IPs.
probes.note: The SSH-2.0-... banner exposes server software and version.

probes.label: VNC server RFB banner
probes.remediation: Enforce VNC passwords and restrict 5900; prefer SSH tunneling.
probes.note: RFB 003.xxx confirms the server; if the security handshake offers 'None', no-authentication access exists.

probes.label: RDP service detected
probes.remediation: Enable NLA and restrict 3389 from untrusted networks.
probes.note: The X.224 Connection Confirm starts with 0x03 0x00; NLA should be enforced to prevent offline attacks.

probes.label: NTP server responding
probes.remediation: Firewall UDP 123 and use NTP authentication where feasible.
probes.note: The first reply byte is the leap/version/mode nibble (0x1c = NTPv3 server response); check for monlist abuse separately.

probes.label: Oracle WebLogic console exposed
probes.remediation: Restrict /console and patch WebLogic (CVE-2020-14882 class of flaws).
probes.note: Console login reachable; unpatched consoles have unauthenticated RCE history.

probes.label: Apache Tomcat reachable
probes.remediation: Restrict 8080/8443 and secure manager/host-manager with roles and strong credentials.
probes.note: The default page discloses the version; /manager may be unauth or default-creds.

probes.label: JBoss/WildFly web reachable
probes.remediation: Restrict the management console (9990) and patch; disable legacy invoker servlets.
probes.note: An exposed admin console or invoker endpoint historically yields deserialization RCE on unpatched versions.

probes.label: Apache Solr admin API exposed
probes.remediation: Enable auth/ACLs on Solr, firewall 8983, and patch the Log4j (CVE-2021-44228) class.
probes.note: log4shell-era vector surface; the unauthenticated admin API allows core management and data access.

probes.label: Jenkins reachable
probes.remediation: Restrict 8080, lock down the security realm and the Groovy script console.
probes.note: Version is shown in the footer; an open or weak-auth Jenkins allows code execution via build jobs.

probes.label: GitLab reachable
probes.remediation: Keep GitLab patched and restrict instance visibility.
probes.note: The sign-in page confirms GitLab; unauthenticated API and token issues are covered by other modules.

probes.label: Grafana reachable
probes.remediation: Restrict 3000 to trusted users, configure auth, and patch known CVEs.
probes.note: Older builds print 'Anonymous access is enabled'; verify /api/health and dashboard permissions.

probes.label: Kafka REST endpoint reachable
probes.remediation: Require authentication on Connect/Schema Registry REST and firewall these ports.
probes.note: Kafka Connect (8083) and Schema Registry (8081) reply with JSON including version; unauthenticated connector creation is RCE-adjacent.
